name: Lupin Ltd
title: Lupin Ltd - 500257 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Lupin posted record Q4 with 29.4% EBITDA margin and 75% gross margin, but guides FY27 to ~25% margin and high-single-digit growth as Tolvaptan and Mirabegron face competition; US revenue guided to high-single or low-double-digit erosion.

triggers.label: FY27 margin guide ~25% from 29.7%
triggers.quote: we expect to grow our top line high-single digits with margins at around 25% in FY27

triggers.label: Tolvaptan and Mirabegron generic competition
triggers.quote: we have factored that in both competition for Mirabegron as well as Tolvaptan

triggers.label: US erosion high-single to low-double digit FY27
triggers.quote: maybe it's a high single digit or low double-digit erosion in terms of revenues

triggers.label: Q4 US sales USD 371m, +6% QoQ cc
triggers.quote: the U .S business recorded sales of USD 371 million, 6% higher QoQ in constant currency terms

triggers.label: Gross margin 75% from 61.7% YoY
triggers.quote: Gross Margins continued their upward trajectory during the quar ter at 75% up from 61.7% in Q4 FY25

guidance.quote: we expect to grow our top line high-single digits with margins at around 25% in FY27
we expect to grow our top line high-single digits with margins at around 25% in FY27
In FY27 to be a billion dollar plus.
We expect R&D to be around 8% of sales for the next fiscal.
For FY27, we expect the ETR to be about 25% - 26%
we remain confident that our India formulations business will continue to outperform IPM by 1.2x to 1.3x going forward
